text:
maya: Quick update — scheduled change window at 00:00 PT this Thu. Requesting quiet window 23:45-02:00 PT. Please confirm: canary owner, rollback owner, and pin list by EOD today. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.2.2 :eyes:

ara: I'll own canary metrics & perf smoke. Will be online 23:20-00:40 PT to watch tail latencies and mem.

josh: I'll run canary traffic shift and smoke runner. Planning to bring up 3 canary instances at 23:30 and start 2% traffic.

olivia: Rollback lead. If we hit >1% 5xx sustained for 5m OR latency +120ms p95 sustained for 10m, we start rollback. Decision window: 10 minutes from alert.

maya: Ops preflight (copy of things to verify) — small, actionable list:
```
- Reserve: lock 4 dedicated GPU slots for canary (start 30m prior)
- Warmup: run route-level warmups for top-k routes (10m each)
- Smoke: run auth + rate-limit tests (3 rounds)
- Routing: 2% -> 5% -> 10% progression with gating checks
- Observability: verify dashboards load and alert hooks set to lower thresholds
- Pin: pin model to tag v3.2.2 at 23:55 if canary healthy
- Rollback: have rollback command pre-approved and unpin plan ready
```

josh: Preflight smoke quick-run (CI agent):
```bash
RELEASE_KEY=redacted
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_KEY" \n  -d '{"model":"llm-redwood:v3.2.2","input":"smoke-run"}'
```

deploy-bot: Freeze scheduled by @maya. Queued actions: reserve-pool, warmup, pin (pending manual approve). Use `/deploy status 6112233445` to follow. :robot_face:

ara: I'll run synthetic load for `/chat`, `/complete`, `/embed`, `/search`, `/re-rank`. Posting heatmap at T-15.

sam (oncall): I'll drop alert thresholds for the window: 5xx > 0.8% or p95 +80ms. Pager on. Ping me in-thread for any suspected infra noise.

olivia: Rollback exec command (pre-approved): `deploy rollback model:llm-redwood --to-tag=v3.2.1 --reason="urgent-rollback"` and `deploy unpin model:llm-redwood`. I will execute or authorize.

josh: Suggest enabling prefix-cache preload for the top 5 endpoints 20m before window to reduce cold starts. I'll push the config at 23:25.

maya: Note on rollforward: if we rollback and then want to rollforward again, require 45m cool-down + explicit sign-off from rollback owner.

deploy-bot: Warmup started: pool-id p-9932, instances 3 -> healthy checks passing (req cb-6112233445-1).

ara: Warmup heatmap: tail latency stable, token-cost delta within expected. Uploading trace links: https://observability.internal/trace/6112233445

maya: Final readiness call: confirm owners and pin list now. If no objections, we'll proceed with the scheduled quiet window and I'll post a 30-minute reminder. :thumbsup:

olivia: Confirmed. I'm rollback owner.

josh: Confirmed. Canary owner and smoke runner.

sam (oncall): Confirmed monitoring.

maya: Thanks — proceeding. Will post T-30 and T-5 reminders in this thread.
